theme_central: Consistency between word and deed, fighting in ranks "as if a solid structure" — with Aissa's prophecy announcing the coming of Ahmad (Muhammad).
sources_note: Precisely sourced structure (mudahamatan.home.blog, Tafsir Ibn Kathir): 1-4, 5-6, 7, 8-9, 10-13, 14.

branches.title: Saying and doing
branches.resume: Why do you say what you do not do? Allah loves those who fight in solid ranks.

children.t: Consistency between word and deed, fighting in solid ranks

branches.title: Musa and Aissa's prophecy
branches.resume: Musa rebukes his people; Aissa announces the coming of a messenger named Ahmad.

children.t: Musa rebukes his people; Aissa announces Ahmad (Muhammad)

branches.title: Who invents a lie against Allah?
branches.resume: Rhetorical question about the injustice of lying about Allah while being called to Islam.

children.t: Who invents a lie against Allah while being called to Islam?

branches.title: Allah's light will prevail
branches.resume: Attempt to extinguish Allah's light with the mouth, doomed to fail.

children.t: Allah's light will prevail despite the disbelievers

branches.title: The profitable trade
branches.resume: Faith, struggle and spending: a trade that saves from painful punishment.

children.t: Faith, struggle and spending as profitable trade

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Being helpers of Allah, like the disciples of Aissa.

children.t: Being helpers of Allah, like the disciples of Aissa
